name: Back Lever
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip, tuck your knees, and roll smoothly backward into an inverted hang.
With straight elbows, extend your legs together as you lower your hips behind you.
Stop when your straight body faces the floor in a horizontal line parallel to the ground.
Hold the horizontal line steadily for the target duration, then tuck your knees and reverse safely back to a hang.
tips: Keep strong shoulder and biceps tension throughout the descent rather than dropping rapidly into the hold.
Squeeze your glutes and abs tightly so your lower back does not arch downward.
